category_title: Students with a history of school failure and distrust of adults
minimal_context: The student and tutor are sitting in a breakout room with tea to complete classroom work sessions required for a pass grade.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's start our classroom work session so you can get the pass grades needed to be accepted into the national programme.

STUDENT: I don't want to work.

TUTOR: Are you motivated to work on this today?

STUDENT: No.

TUTOR: You just need to keep trying and do the work.

STUDENT: What's the point? The only thing I know that I can do is fail. I am terribly good at that, and I'm just disappointed in school and adults.

options.A: Guide the student through a healing-lake visualization during the work sessions, encouraging them to observe that the lake is always changing yet always itself.
options.B: Welcome the student and emphasize looking to the future rather than the past, framing the work sessions as a second chance they can choose to take.
options.C: Place an exclusive display board in the breakout room solely for the student to display their completed classroom work throughout the term.
options.D: Subdivide the classroom work sessions into 15-minute segments and introduce short breaks between the learning activities throughout the term.
